# Nib

> Nib (nibtools.com) is a collection of fast, free, privacy-friendly browser
> tools for everyday tasks. Most tools run entirely in the user's browser, so
> the data entered is never uploaded. No accounts, no paywall.

## Calculators
- [Percentage Calculator](https://nibtools.com/percentage-calculator): Percentages, percentage change, increase and decrease.
- [Age Calculator](https://nibtools.com/age-calculator): Exact age in years, months and days from a birth date.
- [Ratio Calculator](https://nibtools.com/ratio-calculator): Simplify, scale and solve ratios.
- [Discount Calculator](https://nibtools.com/discount-calculator): Sale prices and savings.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://nibtools.com/date-difference-calculator): Days, weeks and months between two dates.

## Finance
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://nibtools.com/mortgage-calculator): Monthly mortgage payment (principal, interest, taxes, insurance) and total cost.
- [Loan Calculator](https://nibtools.com/loan-calculator): Monthly payment and total interest for any fixed-rate loan.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://nibtools.com/compound-interest-calculator): How savings grow with compound interest and contributions.
- [Tip Calculator](https://nibtools.com/tip-calculator): Tip amount, total and per-person split.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://nibtools.com/sales-tax-calculator): Add or remove sales tax from a price.

## Developer Tools
- [JSON Formatter](https://nibtools.com/json-formatter): Format, validate and minify JSON in the browser.
- [UUID Generator](https://nibtools.com/uuid-generator): Generate v4 and v7 UUIDs.
- [Base64 Encoder / Decoder](https://nibtools.com/base64-encoder): Encode and decode Base64 text.
- [URL Encoder / Decoder](https://nibtools.com/url-encoder): Percent-encode and decode URLs.
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://nibtools.com/timestamp-converter): Convert between Unix timestamps and dates.

## Text Tools
- [Word Counter](https://nibtools.com/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences and reading time.
- [Character Counter](https://nibtools.com/character-counter): Count characters against common limits.
- [Text Case Converter](https://nibtools.com/case-converter): Convert text between letter cases.
- [Text Diff](https://nibtools.com/text-diff): Compare two texts and highlight changes.
- [Remove Duplicate Lines](https://nibtools.com/remove-duplicate-lines): Delete duplicate lines from a list.

## Time & Random
- [Random Number Generator](https://nibtools.com/random-number-generator): Random numbers in a range.
- [Coin Flip](https://nibtools.com/coin-flip): Flip a fair virtual coin.
- [Dice Roller](https://nibtools.com/dice-roller): Roll dice with any number of sides.
- [Online Timer](https://nibtools.com/timer): Countdown timer with presets and an alarm.
- [Stopwatch](https://nibtools.com/stopwatch): Precise stopwatch with lap times.

## About
- [About Nib](https://nibtools.com/about): What Nib is and the thinking behind it.
- [All Tools](https://nibtools.com/tools): Full index of every tool.
- [Privacy](https://nibtools.com/privacy): How Nib handles data (most tools run on-device).
